findings.evidence: The disabled-dimming and filled-variant tests assert on CSS source text via regex (and stroke=currentColor) because jest maps CSS to identity-obj-proxy; they would fail if the rules were removed, but not if another rule overrode them.
findings.description: Stronger proof would be a computed-style check or a visual check. Not blocking: the tests would notice the CSS rule being deleted or the icon stroke changing.

findings.evidence: The focus-ring test checks the shared CSS rule and class per type; jsdom cannot show a real ring in light and dark themes.
findings.description: Real-theme visibility is only checked structurally. Acceptable for a CSS-variable library.

findings.evidence: The build report says npm run build succeeds but records no dist/index.esm.js size delta. The non-functional requirement asks for the number (15 KB cap) to be recorded in the review. No .size-limit.json exists.
findings.description: Measure and record the bundle growth by hand. Advisory because no automated size check exists in this project.

findings.evidence: Project notes say there is no scripts/consumer-smoke.mjs, so the packed library is never installed and imported under CommonJS and ES modules. The report mentions no npm pack --dry-run.
findings.description: The packed-library check did not run, and the scaffolding is not set up. This is not blocking because the request did not ask for it.
